phase3_empty_recovery_enabled.description: Only empty final replies: one 12-second text-only continuation, durable maximum four attempts per Shanghai day; no tool replay

send_timeout_seconds.description: Offline single text send timeout; timeout is unknown and never automatically retried.

phase3_enabled.description: Opt in to Phase3 migration, input grouping and controlled multi-send. Requires release approval.

phase3_admin_id.description: Authorized private QQ target; runtime only.

phase3_proactive_enabled.description: Requires separate approved proactive window; stays false by default.

phase3_multibubble_enabled.description: Use pinned semantic parser and one bounded Guard send loop. Can be disabled independently.

phase3_casual_split_fallback_enabled.description: V3.1 optional fallback: at most 100 Unicode codepoints, 2-4 complete sentences; merge short sentences (<6 letters/digits), keep 2-4 exact bubbles. Excludes structured/technical/search replies; existing Guard sender only.

phase3_bubble_min_interval.description: Lower bound of a fresh uniform random wait after each confirmed bubble. The first bubble uses its separate first-delay settings.

phase3_bubble_max_interval.description: Upper bound of the random inter-bubble wait (validated at most 4 seconds). Existing interruption and confirmation rules remain in effect.

phase3_first_bubble_min_delay.description: Lower bound of an interruptible random wait before the first bubble of each normal/final/proactive plan, including one-bubble replies. Search progress stays immediate. Both first-delay values at 0 disable this wait; old configs retain immediate first send.

phase3_first_bubble_max_delay.description: Upper bound of first-bubble waiting, validated 0 <= min <= max <= 4 seconds. Wait happens outside the transport timeout; does not alter attempts, receipts or confirmed history. Approved release uses 0.8–1.8 seconds.

phase3_plain_text_enabled.description: Bounded cosmetic Markdown removal before QQ text delivery. Keeps code content and link URLs; can be disabled independently.
